programs.name: Stellar 2-Step (CFD)
programs.drawdown_type: static (balance or equity must stay above 90% of initial balance)
programs.consistency_rule: none (N/A) on the default 21-day cycle; the On-Demand payout option requires best day at most 40% of profit
programs.profit_split: 80% default (21-day cycle); 60% (3 Profitable Days option); 90% (On-Demand option); 90% after Scale-Up; 95% with paid Lifetime add-on
programs.payout_frequency: first reward after 21 days, then every 14 days (default)
programs.payout_rules_note: Fee refunded with the first reward. A 15% challenge reward (of the Phase 1 + 2 targets) is paid once Scale-Up criteria are met (accounts bought from 2026-01-12); not available to US traders. On funded: max 3% open risk at any time; profits from trades within ±5 min of high-impact news count at 40% only; Quick Strike (trades closed within 30s) must stay below 30% of profit.
programs.notes: Sizes: 6K, 15K, 25K, 50K, 100K, 200K. 50K targets: Phase 1 8% ($4,000), Phase 2 5% ($2,500). Daily loss is 5% of initial balance. EAs are NOT allowed at $50K and above. The October promo (STRTN) covers only the 6K size.

programs.name: Stellar 1-Step (CFD)
programs.drawdown_type: static (balance or equity must stay above 94% of initial balance)
programs.profit_split: 80% default for accounts bought or reset from 2026-01-12 (90% for earlier accounts); 90% after Scale-Up; 95% with Lifetime add-on
programs.payout_frequency: every 5 business days (if in profit for the cycle)
programs.payout_rules_note: Refundable fee paid with the 3rd reward for accounts bought from 2026-01-12 (1st reward before that). Max 3% open risk on funded; news profits at 40%; Quick Strike below 30%.
programs.notes: Sizes 6K to 200K. 10% target, 3% daily, 6% max loss. EAs not allowed at $50K and above.

programs.name: FundedNext Futures Rapid Pro
programs.drawdown_type: EOD trailing (locks at starting balance + $100, i.e. $50,100)
programs.consistency_rule: none in the challenge; 40% on the funded account (highest day at most 40% of total profit to withdraw)
programs.payout_rules_note: 50K: minimum withdrawal $250, max $1,200 per cycle, at least $500 profit in the cycle, no buffer. Account concludes after 5 Performance Rewards. Live review after 15 rewards across the trader profile (not guaranteed). Optional $1,000 daily-loss-limit add-on lowers the price. A Rapid Daily variant has daily payouts and a $1,000 DLL.
programs.notes: Discounted price varies by official page (seen 2026-10-16): $159.99 on the product page, $149.99 in the help-center rules article, $169.99 in the help-center price article; all list $299.98 (code RAPID, 'up to 50%'). Overnight holding is not allowed on futures. Flex (cheaper: 50K list $141.99, $1,500 EOD drawdown, $2,500 target, 95% split, 5-day payouts, $1,500 cap) is also sold.

news_trading: CFD: allowed in challenge phases; on funded accounts, profits from trades within ±5 minutes of high-impact news on correlated pairs count at only 40% (losses count in full). Futures: Flex page says news trading is allowed
ea_bots_allowed: CFD: restricted. Allowed on MT4/MT5 for accounts below $50K (with conditions and a usage fee); not allowed at $50K and above, not on cTrader/Match-Trader, and not for US clients; prop-passing EAs are banned. Futures: automated bots/AI allowed per the Futures Challenge Terms (subject to review)
copy_trading: CFD: allowed only between Challenge accounts of the same trader; prohibited between different people and on any FundedNext (funded) account. Futures: copying/mirroring trades across multiple accounts is prohibited per the terms
overnight_weekend_holding: CFD: overnight allowed on all account types; weekend holding allowed on Challenge and FundedNext accounts (reinstated 2026-05-08 after a pause from 2026-01-17). Futures: holding beyond market close is not allowed
restricted_countries_note: CFD terms: North Korea, Myanmar, Belarus, Iran, Russia (Terms of Service also add Vietnam). Futures has a longer list (about 50 countries, incl. Bangladesh, Malaysia, Ukraine, Vietnam, Albania, Sri Lanka): https://helpfutures.fundednext.com/en/articles/17228971-are-any-countries-restricted-on-fundednext-futures
path_to_live: Futures: review after 15 Performance Rewards across the trader profile (then every 5 for returning traders), not guaranteed; up to 5 live accounts; Challenge accounts closed on transfer. CFD: no live route published (Scale-Up program raises split to 90%).

current_public_promo.discount: Up to 33% off (up to 20% for US traders)
current_public_promo.applies_to: Only the 6K CFD challenge, from October 12, 2026; FundedNext says it may end at any time

affiliate_program.commission: Tiered: Galactic 12%, Cosmic 15%, Infinity 18% (tiers unlocked by monthly commission of $1,000 / $2,500 / $6,000)
affiliate_program.notes: Cosmic/Infinity are demoted after 3 consecutive months below target. The entry 'Star' tier rate was not stated in the article read.

recent_changes_2026.change: Stellar product update: 1-Step default split cut from 90% to 80% (90% after Scale-Up); 1-Step fee refund moved from the 1st to the 3rd reward; 15% challenge reward tied to Scale-Up
Weekend holding paused on Stellar funded accounts (reported by a third-party tracker)
US traders can no longer buy new cTrader accounts; US CFD clients use Match-Trader only
Weekend holding reinstated for Stellar 1-Step, 2-Step and Lite accounts (reported by a third-party tracker)
Futures lineup now Rapid Pro, Rapid Daily, Legacy and Flex (plus Direct); Flex sold with 'launch price'

pros: Large, established operation: Trustpilot 4.5 from about 81,760 reviews; FundedNext launched March 2022
Accepts US traders for both CFD and futures
Stellar 2-Step uses a static 10% max loss, and the fee is refunded with the first reward
Futures Rapid Pro has no daily loss limit, a 90% split, payouts every 3 days and no buffer
Many payout methods (crypto, Rise, bank, card)
cons: Default CFD split is 80%; higher splits need Scale-Up, add-ons or a different payout schedule
EAs banned on CFD accounts of $50K and above, and for all US CFD clients
Funded news-trading profits count at only 40% (±5 min window); 3% max-risk rule on funded
Rules changed several times in 2026 (Jan 12 split/refund changes, weekend-holding pause and reinstatement); Trustpilot summary notes complaints about accounts deactivated after moving to live
best_for: Traders who want both CFD and futures options from one large firm, including US residents (CFD via Match-Trader).
